commit.message:
fix(auth): broaden BUD-01 GET acceptance per Postel's law (#129)

Three small relaxations on the BUD-01 GET auth path so we accept what
real-world clients actually send, while still rejecting obviously bad
auth events:

1. Auth-scheme prefix is now case-insensitive — `Nostr `, `nostr `,
   `NOSTR ` all parse. RFC 7235 says auth-scheme tokens are
   case-insensitive and clients have shipped lowercase variants.

2. The `t` action tag is matched case-insensitively in get_action(), so
   `Get` / `GET` / `gEt` all map to AuthAction::Get. The Blossom spec
   doesn't mandate case for the action value.

3. validate_blossom_get_event now accepts events with multiple `x`
   tags — BUD-01 allows authorising multiple blobs in one event, but
   we previously only checked the first x tag and rejected when the
   match was elsewhere in the list. Now we iterate every x tag and
   accept if any matches the requested hash.

Out of scope: case-insensitive NIP-98 method tag and URL canonicalisation
(query-strip / trailing-slash). Defer until we see a concrete client
reporting that pattern.

Tests: 30 viewer_auth + 99 blossom-core pass (5 new regression tests
covering all three relaxations + a "still rejects when truly invalid"
counter-test).

commit.message:
fix(auth): dispatch BUD-01 viewer auth based on path context (#127)

* fix(auth): dispatch BUD-01 viewer auth based on path context

diagnose_viewer_auth_request always dispatched BUD-01 (kind 24242)
events to validate_viewer_event which requires AuthAction::List. Blob
viewer requests (e.g. /sha256.ext) need AuthAction::Get, causing valid
get-scoped auth to be rejected with "Invalid action tag."

Use blob_hash_from_path to detect blob paths and route to
validate_blob_viewer_event (which checks AuthAction::Get + hash match)
when appropriate. Move blob_hash_from_path to viewer_auth as shared
pub(crate) helper.

Closes #126

* test: regression tests for BUD-01 viewer auth dispatch on blob paths

Covers the exact dispatch path that was broken: diagnose_viewer_auth_request
now routes BUD-01 get events to validate_blob_viewer_event on blob paths.

- Accepts BUD-01 get+hash on blob path (was rejected before fix)
- Rejects BUD-01 list on blob path (blob paths require get)
